scenario: Both `call` and `after` admit an `as <expr>` clause per LRST.1.1. Pin: `after 5_min as t.entity_id:` (using an LHS binding expression as the supersedure key) compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

rule auto_off:
    Motion m where m.state == true
->
    log info "on"
    after 5_min as m.entity_id:
        log info "off after delay"
